title: Symmetry
subject: Mathematics
description: When one side is a mirror of the other — butterflies, hearts, and shapes!
source: NSC Practice — built from the official MOE Grade 2 curriculum
nscObjectives: Recognise lines of symmetry in shapes and letters

sections.title: What is Symmetry?
sections.description: A shape is symmetrical when you can fold it in half and both sides match exactly — like a mirror!

questions.prompt: A shape is symmetrical when you fold it in half and...
questions.hint: Like folding a paper heart — both halves are the same!

questions.prompt: The fold line that splits a symmetrical shape into two matching halves is called a...
questions.hint: It's the special line where both sides mirror each other

questions.prompt: Which of these living things is famous for having matching wings — a great example of symmetry?
questions.hint: Its left wing mirrors its right wing!

questions.prompt: If you fold a heart shape ❤️ down the middle from top to bottom, what happens?
questions.hint: That's why a heart is symmetrical!

questions.prompt: Your face is roughly symmetrical. Where would its line of symmetry be?
options: straight down the middle of your nose
questions.correct: straight down the middle of your nose
questions.hint: One eye on each side, one cheek on each side...

questions.prompt: Select ALL the things that are symmetrical:
questions.hint: Try folding the letter F in your mind — the sides don't match!

sections.title: Symmetry in Letters and Numbers
sections.description: Some letters and numbers are symmetrical too! Imagine folding them in half.

questions.prompt: Which letter is symmetrical if you fold it down the middle (left half matches right half)?
questions.hint: The letter A has a matching left and right side

questions.prompt: Select ALL the letters with left-right symmetry:
questions.hint: Fold each letter in your mind — P's bump is only on one side!

questions.prompt: Which letter is NOT symmetrical?
questions.hint: R has a leg sticking out on one side only

questions.prompt: The letter O is special. How is it symmetrical?
questions.hint: A circle matches every way you fold it!

questions.prompt: Which number is symmetrical if you fold it left-to-right?
questions.hint: The number 8 is two circles stacked — fold it down the middle!

questions.prompt: Morgan writes the word 'MOM'. Why does it look balanced?
options: Each letter is symmetrical and the word reads the same way
questions.correct: Each letter is symmetrical and the word reads the same way
questions.hint: M, O, and M all have left-right symmetry!

sections.title: Symmetry in Shapes
sections.description: How many ways can you fold a shape so the halves match?

questions.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
questions.hint: Fold top-to-bottom, side-to-side, and corner-to-corner both ways!

questions.prompt: A rectangle (not a square) has how many lines of symmetry?
questions.hint: Top-to-bottom and side-to-side — but corner folds DON'T match!

questions.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
questions.hint: Every fold through the centre of a circle matches!

questions.prompt: A triangle with all 3 sides EQUAL has how many lines of symmetry?
questions.hint: One fold from each corner to the middle of the opposite side

questions.prompt: Which shape has NO line of symmetry?
questions.hint: Messy shapes with no matching halves are NOT symmetrical

questions.prompt: Match each shape to its number of lines of symmetry:
questions.hint: Square folds 4 ways, rectangle 2 ways, scribble none!

questions.prompt: Type the missing word: 'When both halves of a shape match exactly, the shape has ___.'
questions.hint: It starts with 's' — the big word this whole quiz is about!

questions.prompt: The Jamaican flag has a big X across it. If you fold it from left to right, do the halves match?
options: Yes — the left and right sides mirror each other
questions.correct: Yes — the left and right sides mirror each other
questions.hint: The X makes matching green and black triangles on each side!
